meaning: The fit target is fixed to the respiration-free 1 Hz mean ICP series (DATA_MEAN, :icp) over the measured window only. Every parameter estimated in this fit is therefore constrained by mean ICP alone, not by pulsatile or out-of-window behaviour.

could_move.what: All M5 parameters fitted here flow into the M5 curve compared against data
Cross-model M1 vs M5 comparisons inherit any bias from the mean-only target
M4 vs M5 comparison, if M4 was fitted to a different target definition
The dynamic system is exercised only through this mean target, so dynamic-only parameters may be weakly identified

expectation: Unknown in size. Direction: parameters acting mainly on pulse amplitude or outside the measured window are likely under-determined, so they can take a wide range of values while mean ICP still matches. I cannot tell from this context which parameters those are.

check.why: Re-runs the existing verification stage for the M5 fit without a full re-fit, checking the fitted parameters against the mean-ICP target and its residual diagnostics.
